module: Module 5: Partial Fills, Asymmetric Rejections & Slippage
title: Slippage Tolerance Violation on Child Orders
precondition: Master sets max slippage tolerance = 2.0 pips; market slips 3.5 pips.
expected_result: Child order rejected or executed with price improvement; investor protected from off-market fills.
actual_result: Configured slippage tolerance protects investors by rejecting fills outside maximum allowable pips.
